an10.175:1.1: saparikkamano ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo aparikkamano.
an10.175:1.2: kathañca bhikkhave saparikkamano ayaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo aparikkamano:
an10.175:1.3: pāṇātipātissa bhikkhave pāṇātipātā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti.
an10.175:1.4: adinnādānassa bhikkhave adinnādānā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti.
an10.175:1.5: kāmesu micchācārissa bhikkhave kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti.
an10.175:1.6: musāvādissa bhikkhave musāvādā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti.
an10.175:1.7: pisunāvācassa bhikkhave pisunāvācā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti.
an10.175:1.8: pharusāvācassa bhikkhave pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti.
an10.175:1.9: samphappalāpissa bhikkhave samphappalāpā veramaṇī parikkamanaṃ hoti.
an10.175:1.13: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, saparikkamano ayaṃ dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo aparikkamanoti.
